result.instructions: Tools for Workbooks, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find every organisation in Workbooks whose name starts with 'Acme'."; "Show the open tasks due this week and who they are assigned to."; "List the activities logged against person 1234 in the last 30 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Workbooks data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run workbooks_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run workbooks_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run workbooks_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. workbooks_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: workbooks_search_people
tools.title: Search people
tools.description: Search CRM people (contacts) with optional filters and paging. Workbooks API: GET /crm/people.api.

filters.description: Filters combined with AND. Up to 10.

type.description: Operator: eq equals, bg begins with, ct contains, gt/ge greater, lt/le less.

value.description: Value to match. Dates use ISO format, e.g. 2026-11-01.
